messages.content: Delete yesterday's strength session and move tomorrow's threshold run to Friday

content.text:
I can't do either of those. The tools I have can read your Garmin data, but none of them can delete activities or reschedule workouts.

You can make both changes in Garmin Connect yourself:

- **Delete yesterday's strength session (17 March):** Open the activity in Garmin Connect (web or app), click the three-dot menu in the top right, and choose Delete Activity.
- **Move the threshold run from tomorrow (Thursday 19th) to Friday (20th):** Open your calendar and find the workout. On the web you can drag it to the new day. In the app, open the workout, choose Reschedule, and pick Friday. If the workout is part of a Garmin Coach or adaptive plan, rescheduling may be limited, or the plan may shift the other sessions around it.

If you'd like, I can look up what's scheduled for the rest of this week. That would let me check whether Friday already has a hard session or a rest day, so you can see how the move fits. I can also pull up yesterday's strength session to confirm which activity you're deleting.
